allow: Bash(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3099/api/chat -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"How can I contact you, and how do I donate?"}]}' -w "\\nchat:%{http_code}\\n")

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3099 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue })
